summary: Approves the fiscal year 2027 rules for the Community Arts Leaders of Nashville Internship Program, which gives $6,700 grants to Nashville arts groups to hire arts-focused undergraduate interns and match them with mentors. The rules now define an "arts-focused nonprofit," have host sites add interns as W-2 or IRS Form 1099 employees, remove ten paid hours of time off for interns, and bar mentors from being employees of the host site.
